Exercise: Side-Lying Floor Stretch

Category:
stretching

Exercise Type:
None

Force Type:
static

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- unilateral_static_stretch

Primary Muscles:

- lats

Secondary Muscles:
None

Equipment:
None

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
3

Energy Requirement:
low

Recovery Time:
0.5 hours

Goals:

- improve_flexibility
- relax_lats

Contraindications:

- acute injuries
- severe joint pain

Exercise Variations:
None

Substitution Options:
None

Instructions:

- First lie on your left side, bending your left knee in front of you to stabilize your torso (use your abdominal muscles as well to hold you upright).
- Straighten your right leg and rest the right foot on the floor behind your left. Straighten your right arm over your head and gently pull on your right wrist to stretch the entire right side of the body. Switch sides.
